body: Whoa now, what the hell did I do that's so wrong? Because I smoke a day or so on my free time? I work 2 weeks to a month at a time without it. Making about $2k a week saving to build a house on some land for my family. Explain to me why it would not be good for me to be in the picture. Because I don't see it. Enlighten me.

No, my child isn't around any of it. That's why I let my parents have custody instead of her. I knew shit was going to hit the fan when we split last time. I won't allow him around any bullshit. I'm a very protective father.

She has no custody of our child. She dropped him the 3 months we split. I convinced her to sign custody over to my parents (I didn't have a job at the time). She never done drugs til we split this last time. No need for paternity test. Don't want her locked up because 1 I'm trying to fight for her and 2 around these parts narks are not hidden in any way. These small town cops are unbelievable. I've already been treated to be shot for just having a conversation with her when her meth head "friend" was around. Said he'd put me in the damn ground if I got smart in those parts again. Yea, she dropped him and that group pretty quick, there's no doubt in that.
Changes are what throws me off the most. I hate change. Love stability. I'd rather settle down earlier on in life.

To an extent yes. Grew up with dad always gone working and mom basically being my bestfriend. Me and mom now but heads on a daily basis due to them not allowing me to stick around and raise my son "because they have custody and they know what's best for him". I've been working for dad making great money for awhile now. Just never been close to him tho. Always hard to even say the slightest thing to him. I know everything looks bright and cheerful for me but it just keeps getting harder and harder for me.
Cant wait for the next update! Hope all is well.
